title: pvGlobalPointAndCellIds
body:
## pvGlobalPointAndCellIds

Assigns global point and cell ids that are unique across all blocks and MPI processes, giving the same id to points duplicated at block or process boundaries (matched within Tolerance) and marking the duplicates as ghost points. Hyper tree grids get cell ids only. Use it before operations that need consistent ids across partitions, such as ghost generation or merging; for simple local indices use generateIds or pvPointAndCellIds.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- With Tolerance 0, points must coincide exactly; meshes written with rounding need a small positive tolerance.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI or client-server behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `GlobalPointAndCellIds`. Identity: `filters/GlobalPointAndCellIds`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.
